capabilities.title: Preserve trusted authorship through native dispatch
capabilities.motivation: Native send, queue and restart paths must preserve accepted authors and execution intent while upstream owns scheduling.
behavior: Native send, queue and restart paths must preserve accepted authors and execution intent while upstream owns scheduling.
Fresh browser sends display a connection-scoped current-actor snapshot immediately; authoritative timeline updates replace it. The display snapshot is never sent as authorship or authorization.

Provisioning admission uses the native persisted lifecycle transaction (provisioning.started) and returns native messageSequence; preappended attributed provision requests supply that sequence when present.
owners: P6R captures verified actors and native dispatch owns execution and cancellation.

The native browser cache owner loads identity once per WebSocket connection, preloads its avatar, and clears/cancels the optional display cache on disconnect or teardown; native request admission remains authoritative.
